name: The Backward Stars
vestige: Khirad, who reads the stars backward
summary: Advantage on Initiative, +5 to passive Perception, and Clairvoyance once per long rest. The price: 1 fewer Hit Point per level, and visions that never let you rest easy.

source.note: A vestige of the Amber Temple (Curse of Strahd chapter 13 in spirit). The vestige's name is the book's; the gift, its benefit, its price and every word here are ours, designed for this game. Found in amber_temple_vault (the hall of vestiges).

benefit.text: You see the next moment a breath before it arrives, and once a day you can look somewhere you are not.

cost.flaw: You see every way a moment could end, mostly badly, and you cannot stop yourself saying so.
cost.text: The visions don't stop when you sleep. You wake worn thin, every morning, for the rest of your life.
